description: This source file implements the backend gateway logic for a server, specifically handling communication with dynamic socket backends, process management, connection establishment, and request handling within the lighttpd server. It includes functions for managing backend processes, socket connections, load balancing, and maintaining server state related to fastcgi or similar backends.

classes.name: gw_handler_ctx
classes.description: Context structure for managing per-request gateway handling state, including pointers to associated processes, host, extension, buffers, connection state, and other request-specific information.

classes.name: gw_extension
classes.description: Represents a backend extension, managing its list of hosts, key, usage, and last used index.

classes.name: gw_host
classes.description: Represents a backend host, including configuration, process list, load, connection details, and related metadata.

classes.name: gw_proc
classes.description: Represents an individual backend process, including process ID, state, load, connection details, and statistics counters.

classes.name: gw_exts
classes.description: Container for multiple gw_extension objects, holding their array and usage count.

classes.name: gw_plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data structure holding extensions, configuration, and global state.
